review:
Phoenix Forge is a 3x5, 20-payline slot with a tumble mechanic and a Hot Spot Multiplier feature. When winning symbols land, their cells are marked, and the multiplier on those positions increases with every tumble.

The Hot Spot Multiplier works in both the base game and free spins, and the phoenix bonus symbol triggers the bonus when three or more appear. Combining tumbles with hot spots on a standard line layout is less common than on cluster games. The advertised maximum is 5,000x and the RTP is 96.51%. A good option if you like position multipliers but prefer paylines to clusters.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
